subject: general
question: An article was sold at 75% of its marked price and thus gained 25%. The cost price of the article is:
solution:
**Given:**

An article was sold at 75% of its marked price and thus gained 25%.

**Calculation:**

Let the marked price be ₹100 units

So, selling price = 100 units × 75%

⇒ ₹75 units

Now,

Cost price + Cost price × 25% = 75a

⇒ 1.25cost price = 75 units

⇒ Cost price = 75 units/1.25

⇒ ₹60 units

**∴ The cost price of the article is ₹60 units.**
